concept.name: C21 Flow-Confirmed Revision Momentum
concept.construction: Interaction (product of cross-sectional z-scores) of analyst EPS up-revision (consensus blend: eps_chg_1m + esbr, 0.5/0.5) CONFIRMED by smart-money flow (Foreign+Institutional 20d net-buy / Size). Two NON-return information sets. anchor = G(gated) = z_rev * max(z_flow,0), 20d flow window, blend revision leg, top_n=20.
concept.variants: P(raw product z_rev*z_flow) / G(gated z_rev*max(z_flow,0)) [anchor] / S(signed-floor, zr<0&zf<0 clamped to 0)
concept.economic_rationale: Mechanism hypothesis: a revision that informed investors are NOT buying is stale/already-priced; one they ARE buying carries incremental info (revision-drift arbitraged faster when flow present). The PRODUCT was hypothesized to capture conditional info a linear combo misses. EMPIRICAL RESULT REFUTES the conditioning value (see findings) — the flow-confirmation gate destroys rather than enhances the revision signal.
concept.redundancy_cluster_id: consensus_revision (C02/C04/C19 family); flow leg shares INV01/INV03/INV10 cluster
concept.non_return_note: Neither leg touches any M* return-momentum factor. Revision = analyst consensus; flow = investor net-buy notional. Structurally orthogonal to M01/M08/M24 return-momentum.

DECISIVE_INCREMENTALITY_TEST.verdict_rule: rho_active >= 0.85 (0.852) triggers the honest-report condition. Although delta-PORT_t vs linadd is positive (+0.90), the interaction beats linadd ONLY because linadd is poisoned by the negative flow leg. The economically meaningful comparison is vs the revision marginal alone: G(0.939) << M_revOnly(2.795). The gating/product DESTROYS ~1.86 t of revision signal. The conditioning hypothesis is REFUTED — flow does not carry incremental confirmation info; it dilutes/gates away genuine revision alpha.

Active-series rho INV10 0.61 reflects shared flow-leg construction.
